analysis_scope: Only CE-04 addendum C1-C5 at each scale and adjacent-scale differences; no other confirmatory contrasts.

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap over 30 seed differences

C1_N24-N12.definition: C1 at N=24 minus C1 at N=12

C1_N48-N24.definition: C1 at N=48 minus C1 at N=24

C2_N24-N12.definition: C2 at N=24 minus C2 at N=12

C2_N48-N24.definition: C2 at N=48 minus C2 at N=24

C3_N24-N12.definition: C3 at N=24 minus C3 at N=12

C3_N48-N24.definition: C3 at N=48 minus C3 at N=24

C4_N24-N12.definition: C4 at N=24 minus C4 at N=12

C4_N48-N24.definition: C4 at N=48 minus C4 at N=24

C5_N24-N12.definition: C5 at N=24 minus C5 at N=12

C5_N48-N24.definition: C5 at N=48 minus C5 at N=24

scale_comparisons: adjacent N=24−12 and N=48−24 for each C1-C5
unit: independent seed-level replicate; paired within seed and scale
